FX-CYL-001.says: The settings as they start: the drawing wrapped round an upright cylinder half the drawing's half width in radius, in the middle, its middle column facing the viewer, lit from the upper left; its sides fall away round the curve, the corners beside it are transparent, and the inside's far wall is hidden behind the front.

FX-CYL-003.says: Render inside: the inside alone, the far wall, the drawing seen from behind and so mirrored, its middle at the drawing's two side edges.

FX-CYL-004.says: Rotation Y 90: the cylinder turned a quarter about its upright axis, so the drawing three quarters of the way across faces the viewer.

FX-CYL-005.says: Rotation X 30: the cylinder tipped, its top towards the viewer, so the open end shows the inside.

FX-CYL-006.says: Rotation Z 90: the cylinder lying on its side, the drawing's columns wrapped round it from top to bottom and its rows running along it.

FX-CYL-007.says: Radius 100: a cylinder as wide as the drawing, nearer the viewer and so running past the drawing's sides.

FX-CYL-008.says: Radius 0: no cylinder, so nothing is drawn and the layer is transparent.

FX-CYL-009.says: Position Z 100: the cylinder a drawing's width farther away, smaller.

FX-CYL-010.says: Position [25, 50]: the cylinder a quarter of the way across, seen a little from the side.

FX-CYL-011.says: Light intensity 0: the ambient light alone, every pixel the wrapped drawing at 40 per cent.

FX-CYL-012.says: Ambient 100, diffuse 0, specular 0: no shading, the wrapped drawing as it is.

FX-CYL-013.says: An orange light, metal 0: the lit side and the highlight orange; with no blue in the light, blue is the ambient's alone.

FX-CYL-014.says: Roughness 50, specular 100: a larger, duller highlight.

FX-CYL-015.says: Light height -50: the light from behind, so the side facing the viewer is darker.

FX-CYL-016.says: Light direction 90: the light from the right.

FX-CYL-017.says: Rotation Y keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, linear: one whole turn, half way at frame 2.

FX-CYL-018.says: FX-CYL-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, cylinder and all.

FX-CYL-019.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-020.says: Radius 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-021.says: Position Z 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-022.says: Rotation Y 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-023.says: Render "Full": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-024.says: Light color "white": not a #rrggbb colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-025.says: Ambient 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-026.says: Roughness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CYL-027.says: Light height 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
